# Create notes for the remaining files (skip the first one already created)
for file_path in files[1:]:
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)

    # Derive title: filename without .md, replace underscores with spaces

    title = filename[:-3].replace("_", " ")  # remove .md (3 chars)
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    print(f"Created note for {filename}: {result}")
